## Important info

This will clash with any custom skin that modifies Cosmic Destiny Nami chromas. You must own the skin and chromas and choose one of them in champ select. 

This includes tail physics on chromas. If you also want tail physics on base cosmic destiny skin download my [other mod](https://runeforge.dev/mods/7f93ac26-6630-46b9-ad6c-6da150b22101/releases) and make it load before this one.

## Description

**Author**: Suriin

**Skin**: Cosmic Destiny Nami chromas

**Affects**: VFX colors

Adds matching VFX to every chroma, base remains the same.
